    About the data

    A fixed 2024–25 snapshot. Market value is market capitalization at year-end 2024, one lens on the value these companies created; workers, owners, taxes, research and platforms are separate lenses, never added together. Pay is our estimate. Every profile shows each figure’s source and the line it came from.
